Featured project

Role: Designer & FEA Specialist

Tracked Combat Logistics Robot (TCLR)

A heavy-duty tracked platform concept for transporting medical kits, food and equipment.

  • 3D design: frame, payload area and tracked drive in SolidWorks.
  • FEA: stress distribution and load-bearing analysis.
  • 3D-printed tracks: high-traction print-in-place tread links.
  • Embedded: microcontroller for remote navigation and supply deployment.
SolidWorksFEA3D PrintingMicrocontrollersRobotics

Featured project

Role: Designer & FEA Analyst

Agricultural Drone

A foldable quadcopter designed for crop spraying, with firefighting capability as a second use. The folding arms make it compact to carry and quick to deploy.

  • 3D design: foldable frame, arms and spray-tank mounting in SolidWorks.
  • FEA: structural analysis of the arms and frame to check strength under load.
  • Spec: 680 mm wheelbase, 14-inch propellers and a 1-litre spray tank.
  • Electronics: Pixhawk 4 Mini flight controller with T-Motor MT3508 motors.
